before: A date control's text used English month and weekday names whatever the control's language (w:lid), in the editor alone, the room and a fold.
after: The text uses Word's names for the control's language from one fixed table in the engine (store/store/date-names.ts), never the runtime's locale data, so every copy and a fold write the same text; an unknown or missing language gives English.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the text a date value writes for a non-English control changes. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
